title: Interaction-tool
body:
**A convenient and simple tool with a menu for editing Interaction Entity**

---

## Commands list:


```
interaction-tool:it/apply
interaction-tool:it/attack
interaction-tool:it/edit
interaction-tool:it/edit_it
interaction-tool:it/inert_template
interaction-tool:it/interact
interaction-tool:it/new
interaction-tool:it/right_click
interaction-tool:it/tick

interaction-tool:it/zzz/apply
interaction-tool:it/zzz/attack
interaction-tool:it/zzz/check_is_it
interaction-tool:it/zzz/check_is_it_1
interaction-tool:it/zzz/dialog
interaction-tool:it/zzz/fill_dialog
interaction-tool:it/zzz/inject_template
interaction-tool:it/zzz/interact
interaction-tool:it/zzz/move
interaction-tool:it/zzz/rebuild_dialog_from_insert
interaction-tool:it/zzz/run_attack
interaction-tool:it/zzz/run_interaction
```


## advice:

If you don't know what to do, just type " interaction-tool:it/new ", and you will get it.
